claimLedger.claim: Modified Pilates among safer exercises; avoid poses with long stillness or back-lying; avoid hot Pilates; stop for listed warning signs.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ACOG · Exercise During Pregnancy (FAQ119) · Last updated: September 2024; Last reviewed: November 2025
claimLedger.limitations: US FAQ; class quality still depends on local instructor skill.

claimLedger.claim: Tell instructor you are pregnant; avoid prolonged supine lying later in pregnancy; stop if uncomfortable, too hot or unwell.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Exercise in pregnancy · Media last reviewed: 3 February 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK public page; does not grade Pilates brands.

claimLedger.claim: Pilates as gentle non-impact option; continue prior exercise if comfortable without obstetric/medical conditions; lists contraindications; seek physio if PGP or pain with exercises; avoid flat supine after 20 weeks for listed drills.
claimLedger.sourceSection: POGP · Pilates in Women’s Health Physiotherapy · Landing page publication date: 29 Nov 2022
claimLedger.limitations: Booklet also cites birth-outcome associations for general exercise—not used here as a Pilates-specific promise.
